nora_cs: Kickoff: Keystone Labs private deployment prep. Need short status on VPC CIDR, IAM mappings (SSO + service roles), KMS approach (BYOK vs Redwood-managed), and audit log delivery target. Any blockers? cc @ezra_net @tai_se @maya_sec
ezra_net: They propose 10.11.0.0/16. Quick scan: OK for now but confirm no overlap with on-prem SD-WAN ranges. Also decide whether to attach to our TGW or use isolated peering for data residency.
tai_se: IAM: recommend two roles: admin role for their SSO group and service role for Redwood with ExternalId. We'll provide Terraform snippets in runbook.
maya_sec: KMS note: they want BYOK. Security requires proof of key origin and a rotation agreement. We prefer customer-provided key material with 180-day rotation. Also require key policy limiting Decrypt/GenerateDataKey to the Redwood service principal and their log-delivery role.
audit-bot: Audit delivery recommended: S3 in customer account, BlockPublicAccess=true, Object Ownership=bucket-owner-enforced, SSE-KMS (key ARN). Delivery role requires s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl. Retention minimum 365 days. Docs: https://redwood.docs/onboard/audit-s3-forwarding
ezra_net: Networking action: I'll draft the TGW attachment plan and a fallback VPC-peer plan in case the SD-WAN overlap blocks TGW.
tai_se: Action items: 1) nora_cs  confirm SD-WAN ranges with customer, 2) maya_sec  finalize BYOK checklist, 3) ezra_net  PR for TGW + peering options.
nora_cs: Noted. Customer asked if we can delay BYOK and start with Redwood-managed keys for faster pilot; they accept rotation constraints. I'll capture decision matrix and flag renewal-risk if BYOK legal review pushes beyond the pilot window.
maya_sec: Will post BYOK checklist and an example key policy by EOD.
ezra_net: Opening infra PR for TGW + Flow Logs now: https://github.com/redwood/infracluster/pull/1555
nora_cs: Target to resolve outstanding items within 48 hours. Keeping this thread for updates; will add customer replies here.
